initiatives.name: Smart Factory 4.0 Implementation
initiatives.summary: Transform the Warsaw and Wrocław production facilities into fully connected smart factories with real-time monitoring, automated workflows, and AI-driven optimization.
initiatives.description: This flagship initiative aims to digitize our manufacturing floor operations through comprehensive IoT deployment, machine connectivity, and real-time data analytics. The project will connect 200+ machines, implement MES integration, and enable predictive quality control.
initiatives.strategic_alignment: Primary driver of OEE improvement objective

risks.title: Legacy equipment integration complexity
risks.mitigation: Retrofit sensors and edge gateways for older machines

risks.title: Production disruption during deployment
risks.mitigation: Weekend rollouts with full rollback capability

tasks.title: Machine Connectivity Assessment
tasks.description: Audit all production equipment for connectivity options and retrofit requirements

tasks.title: IoT Platform Selection
tasks.description: Evaluate and select the industrial IoT platform (Azure IoT, AWS IoT, Siemens MindSphere)

tasks.title: Edge Infrastructure Deployment
tasks.description: Install edge computing nodes and network infrastructure in Warsaw plant

tasks.title: MES Integration Phase 1
tasks.description: Integrate 50 critical machines with Manufacturing Execution System

tasks.title: Real-time Dashboard Development
tasks.description: Create shop floor visualization dashboards for live production monitoring

tasks.title: Operator Training Program
tasks.description: Train 200+ operators on new digital tools and dashboards

initiatives.name: Predictive Maintenance System
initiatives.summary: Implement AI-driven predictive maintenance to reduce unplanned downtime by 50% and extend equipment lifespan.
initiatives.description: Leverage machine learning models trained on vibration, temperature, and performance data to predict equipment failures before they occur. Initial focus on 30 critical CNC machines and assembly robots.
initiatives.strategic_alignment: Key enabler for unplanned downtime reduction target

tasks.title: Historical Failure Data Analysis
tasks.description: Analyze 3 years of maintenance records to identify failure patterns

tasks.title: Sensor Installation - Phase 1
tasks.description: Install vibration and temperature sensors on 30 critical machines

tasks.title: ML Model Development
tasks.description: Develop and train predictive models for equipment failure prediction

tasks.title: Maintenance Workflow Integration
tasks.description: Integrate predictions with CMMS for automated work order generation

initiatives.name: Digital Twin Platform
initiatives.summary: Create virtual replicas of production lines for simulation, optimization, and what-if analysis.
initiatives.description: Implement digital twin technology to simulate production scenarios, optimize line balancing, and test changes virtually before physical implementation. Starting with Warsaw Assembly Line 3.
initiatives.strategic_alignment: Enables virtual testing and accelerates continuous improvement

tasks.title: Digital Twin Platform Selection
tasks.description: Evaluate Siemens Xcelerator, PTC ThingWorx, and custom solutions

tasks.title: Assembly Line 3 - Data Model
tasks.description: Create detailed 3D model and data schema for pilot line

tasks.title: Real-time Data Integration
tasks.description: Connect live sensor data to digital twin model

initiatives.name: ERP Cloud Migration (SAP S/4HANA)
initiatives.summary: Migrate from legacy SAP ECC to S/4HANA Cloud for modern, real-time business processes.
initiatives.description: Comprehensive ERP modernization including finance, procurement, production planning, and sales. Brownfield migration approach with selective data migration and process optimization.

tasks.title: System Assessment & Fit-Gap
tasks.description: Analyze current customizations and plan migration approach

tasks.title: Data Quality & Cleansing
tasks.description: Clean master data and prepare for migration

tasks.title: Finance Module Go-Live
tasks.description: Deploy S/4HANA Finance with embedded analytics

tasks.title: Production Planning Go-Live
tasks.description: Migrate PP/DS to S/4HANA with advanced scheduling

initiatives.name: Quality Vision AI
initiatives.summary: Deploy computer vision-based quality inspection to reduce defect rates from 1.2% to 0.3%.
initiatives.description: Implement AI-powered visual inspection stations at critical quality checkpoints. The system will detect surface defects, dimensional issues, and assembly errors in real-time.
initiatives.strategic_alignment: Direct impact on quality excellence goal

tasks.title: Defect Taxonomy Definition
tasks.description: Catalog all defect types with visual examples for model training

tasks.title: Training Data Collection
tasks.description: Collect 50,000+ labeled images of good and defective parts

tasks.title: CV Model Development
tasks.description: Train and optimize computer vision models for defect detection

initiatives.name: Supply Chain Visibility Platform
initiatives.summary: Implement end-to-end supply chain visibility with real-time tracking and automated alerts.
initiatives.description: Deploy a cloud-based supply chain tower providing visibility across 120+ suppliers. Enable real-time inventory tracking, lead time monitoring, and risk-based supplier scoring.
initiatives.strategic_alignment: Key for supply chain resilience and inventory optimization

tasks.title: Supplier Onboarding Plan
tasks.description: Define tier-1 and tier-2 supplier integration approach

tasks.title: Control Tower Platform Selection
tasks.description: Evaluate SAP IBP, E2open, and Kinaxis solutions

initiatives.name: Employee Digital Workplace
initiatives.summary: Launch a modern employee portal with self-service, collaboration tools, and mobile access.
initiatives.description: Replace legacy intranet with Microsoft 365-based digital workplace. Enable shift scheduling, training access, HR self-service, and team collaboration from any device.
initiatives.strategic_alignment: Enables digital adoption and workforce engagement

tasks.title: Employee Needs Assessment
tasks.description: Survey workforce on digital tool preferences and pain points

initiatives.name: Energy Management & Optimization
initiatives.summary: Deploy smart energy monitoring and AI-driven optimization to reduce energy costs by 20%.
initiatives.description: Install smart meters, integrate with utility APIs, and use ML to optimize energy consumption patterns. Focus on high-energy equipment and production scheduling.
initiatives.strategic_alignment: Supports sustainability goals and cost reduction

tasks.title: Energy Audit
tasks.description: Comprehensive audit of energy consumption across all facilities
